e2f9503e43f3bb1947bbbe9bf4729f62f8434e1d.summary: Symantec reports that Carderbee, a previously unknown APT group, carried out a supply chain attack using the legitimate Cobra DocGuard software to deploy the Korplug (PlugX) backdoor. Most victims are in Hong Kong, and the attackers used malware signed with a Microsoft certificate. About 100 computers showed malicious activity while the software was installed on around 2,000. Symantec could not link the activity to a known group. ESET earlier attributed a 2022 compromise of a Hong Kong gambling company, using the same software, to Budworm.
